entities.summary: Ngeye Clan is one of the many clans of the present day Buganda Kingdom. Ngeye is a Luganda word which means Colobus Monkey. The Clan Leader is given the title Kasujja and the current Kasujja is Omutaka Kyesimba Kakande Kibirige Sheba. Engeye is one of the clans Kintu found already established in Buganda Kingdom. Bakazirwendo Ssemandwa is the grandfather of the Ngeye Clan.
